Name: Questionable Art Market
Author: Flor3nce2456
Description:
Adds a buyable Art Market storefront of dubious legality. Buy the Museum Rewards and other Difficult-to-get furniture items!

You can purchase it from the Travelling Cart for 100,000 gold, and it has a daily rotating stock of various options.

Nearly every Museum Donation reward is available for sale:
[list]
[*]Sometimes the Iridium Krobus is for sale.
[*]Rarely, an uncommon or end-game double bed might be for sale.
[*]You may occasionally get certain offerings for a pretty good deal, but most of the prices are very high.
[*]Buy the Hero Trophy or the Soda Machine (or a duplicate) when you complete the CC/Joja Warehouse.
[*]If you're really lucky, you might get rare normally-unobtainable furniture for sale!
[/list]
Always only one item per offering, so you may need to wait a few days if you are trying to get multiple of one item.

Coming soon:
[list]
[*]More Progression based Sales! The Store sells more the more donations you make!
[*]Sell Literal Trash at a huge markup!
[*]More of the Fishing items.
[*]More Normally Unobtainable Items!
[*]Light Refreshments???
[/list]

Yes, I made this mod because there was no other mod that added a store where you can but duplicate museum rewards that still works in 1.6.
